summary: First-run testing of Chople's Desk marketing site. Backend: 12/12 pytest cases passed for /api/waitlist and /api/enterprise (create, duplicate handling, case-insensitive email, validation 422s, optional fields, enterprise organisation required). Frontend: Home page loads correctly, hero/masked-reveal renders, waitlist + enterprise dialogs submit successfully and show success states, inline CTA waitlist submits, claim tracer verdicts (Supported / Conflicting values / Not supported) render, ChartStudio all controls present (dataset/view/values/order/toggles/copy/export) and GDP+pie shows pie-warning + switch-line works, compare table has 11 rows with score 11/11, time counter animates to 10, connections graph + 7 thread-steps + 12 graph-nodes render, footer & CTA X/LinkedIn links have correct hrefs, versus queries switch panels, versus-table shows on compare view. Platform page: app-mock nav (research/trends/notes/sources) works, add note updates count badge and note appears in Notes view, delete works, trends selection updates app-trend-selected, app-trend-open-research switches back to research (via lenis scroll from TrendsShowcase or setView from AppMock — TrendsView is rendered twice on page which is intended), depth buttons + query send open waitlist dialog. NotesShowcase sentence toggling and copy work. Mobile (390px): nav-mobile-menu-button opens menu with all links, no horizontal overflow.
critical_code_review_comments: TrendsView is rendered simultaneously by both AppMock (when view==trends) and standalone in TrendsShowcase — this leads to duplicate data-testids like app-trend-open-research (count=2 on /platform). Not a functional bug but complicates automated testing; consider suffixing testids in the standalone showcase (e.g., trends-showcase-trend-open-research) for clarity.

Review-request testid names for form fields did not match actual implementation (e.g., request said 'waitlist-dialog-name' but code exposes 'waitlist-dialog-name-input'; 'enterprise-dialog-*' fields are actually 'enterprise-*-input'; 'enterprise-dialog' testid is on DialogContent). Consider aligning naming or documenting.
hero-demo-format testid exists only during 'format' phase of hero demo cycle (not always in DOM). Consider always rendering the element (empty) or documenting.
Waitlist endpoint returns HTTP 200 for both new signup and duplicate email (differentiated via body 'status'). Consider 201 for created and 200/409 for exists for stricter REST semantics.
server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown'); prefer FastAPI lifespan handler.
MongoDB waitlist collection has no unique index on email — race condition between find_one and insert_one could allow duplicate rows under concurrent load.
seed_data_creation: Test entries prefixed with TEST_ / test+*@example.com inserted into MongoDB waitlist and enterprise_leads collections via pytest and Playwright. Not cleaned up (marketing forms don't expose delete API).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — run with `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v`. Frontend testids: for LeadForms the pattern is `{prefix}-{name|email|org|role}-input` and `{prefix}-submit-button` (waitlist prefix in dialog is 'waitlist-dialog', in cta is 'cta-waitlist'; enterprise uses fixed prefix 'enterprise'). Dialogs identified by testid 'waitlist-dialog' / 'enterprise-dialog'. Time counter is 'time-counter' inside 'time-saved-section'. Two AppMock+TrendsView pairs are rendered on /platform (interactive AppMock at top and standalone TrendsShowcase further down) — use .first when targeting the interactive one.
